scope: Windows x64 MSVC Release fixed-work genuine EW Block-accessor CPU comparison.
limits: Finite API CPU work; no frame FPS, GPU, loading-speed or original-game parity claim.
Both profiles call the actual production accessor through identical function-pointer dispatch and share one compiled workload object.
The candidate changes one cache object in the frozen simulation archive. Other 238 members and dependency libraries remain byte-identical.
The public API retains full success diagnostics. The private failure-only API leaves its caller error untouched on success; that contract difference is checked explicitly.

Published workload adds independently qualified untimed per-control owner assertions and source formatting/include-name changes. Captured samples remain bound to their original private source/object/executable hashes.
The published timed interval has exactly the captured C tokens; separate owner-control qualification does not supply additional timing samples.
Failure equality checks every declared scalar, string, retained identity and nested field without padding. NBT payload unions are inactive and their statuses must be OK.
No affinity or scheduler controls; all initial and confirmation samples and process order are retained separately.

diagnostic_sizes.scope: Actual x64 sizeof values and source-level initialization/copy volume, not measured memory bandwidth.
